page_title: TOU 1-1 NIC | Toulouse v Nice 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Rafik Messali (Toulouse) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
90+3' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) receives a yellow card.
90+3' That's a clear yellow card. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) goes into the book.
90+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+1' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Now Toulouse have a corner.
90+1' Half-chance! Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) plays a pass into the box, but Marcin Bulka reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+1' The referee blows his whistle as Shavy Babicka (Toulouse) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho will be replaced by Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice).
89' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Mendy (Nice) replacing Jonathan Clauss.
88' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) and blew his whistle.
87' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
85' 1 - 1 Goal! Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Marcin Bulka and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:1.
84' Moise Bombito (Nice) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
82' It's time for a substitution. Edhy Zuliani (Toulouse) comes on in place of Jaydee Canvot.
81' Here is a change. Gaetan Laborde is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
79' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle. Jonathan Clauss (Nice) commits a foul after dangerous play.
77' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
76' The referee gives a yellow card to Miha Zajc (Toulouse).
75' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
74' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
69' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moise Bombito (Nice) will replace Ali Abdi.
67' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Evann Guessand and he is replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
66' Today's match ends for Warren Kamanzi who will be replaced by Rafik Messali (Toulouse).
66' A player from Nice commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
66' Nice earn a corner.
65' Joshua King (Toulouse) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
63' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
63' Referee Thomas Leonard sees the trip by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Miha Zajc (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Umit Akdag.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frank Magri leaves the pitch and Joshua King (Toulouse) comes on.
60' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Yann Gboho is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
60' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley high over the bar from inside the box.
58' Rough tackle by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Chance! Frank Magri (Toulouse) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
54' Evann Guessand (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Leonard saw the whole situation.
52' The game is interrupted. Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
51' It looks like Gaetan Laborde (Nice) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
48' The resulting corner from Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
47' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
47' Thomas Leonard blows for a foul after Jonathan Clauss (Nice) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Thomas Leonard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45+1' Dante (Nice) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
45' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) will take a corner kick.
42' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
41' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
41' Frank Magri (Toulouse) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
38' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Evann Guessand (Nice).

37' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Thomas Leonard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
35' A loose ball is pounced on by Yann Gboho (Toulouse) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top of the net, but Marcin Bulka is alert and makes a comfortable save.
33' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) sends it out of play.
31' Jaydee Canvot (Toulouse) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' Dante (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
21' Evann Guessand (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
18' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Guillaume Restes no chance!
18' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
16' Thomas Leonard blows the whistle, Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) is penalised for a foul. It's a penalty! Nice have an opportunity to score from the penalty spot.
16' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Marcin Bulka.
15' Evann Guessand (Nice) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' Dante (Nice) commits a rough foul. Thomas Leonard stops the game and makes a call.
10' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
4' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) was too forceful with his tackle and Thomas Leonard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
3' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
3' Toulouse work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Toulouse, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Foul! Ali Abdi (Nice) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
1' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
1' The first half has just begun.
Nice will kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will referee today's match.
